description: Gaia DR2 passbands used to generate the released Data Release 2 magnitudes and astrophysical parameters for the G, BP and RP bands, as published by Evans et al. (2018).
facility_description: Gaia is a European Space Agency astrometric, photometric and spectroscopic space observatory operating at the Sun-Earth L2 Lagrange point.
notes: Gaia DR2 passbands used to generate the released DR2 magnitudes and astrophysical parameters (Evans et al. 2018, A&A 616, A4). Whole-instrument (telescope optics, filter/prisms, CCD QE) transmissivities for CCD photometry (DetectorType=photon). DetectorType is left unchanged. Distinct from GAIA/DR2r (revised curves) and GAIA/GAIA (EDR3/DR3, Gaia2m BP bright/faint).
